tagline: Leader in experiential dining with a culinary-forward approach and relentless hospitality focus
hero_kpi_rationale: Total revenues reflect the performance of the expanding restaurant portfolio (368 units as of February 23, 2026) and constitute the master KPI for the restaurant sector, driving organic growth via new restaurant openings and comparable sales

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Total revenue of the company, including restaurant sales (The Cheesecake Factory, North Italia, Flower Child and FRC) and bakery operations
kpis.signal: Revenue increase driven by new restaurant openings and the impact of gift card breakage recognition accounting change

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.description: Company gross margin, calculated by subtracting food and beverage costs from total revenue (100% less 21.7% food costs in 2025)
kpis.signal: Gross margin improvement driven by better management of food costs (21.7% in 2025 vs 22.5% in 2024), partly attributable to menu price increases

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.description: Company operating margin, calculated by dividing operating income by total revenues (operating income of 5.0% for both 2025 and 2024)
kpis.signal: Operating margin stability at 5.0% across both years reflecting a balance between cost management and revenue growth

risks.title: Increase in Key Resource Costs
risks.score_rationale: This risk is mentioned in Item 1A and concerns the inability to respond to changes in operating resource costs. The intensity of language 'materially adversely affect' suggests significant severity. The risk is particularly relevant in an inflationary environment where the company implemented menu price increases above historical levels. Risk is stable.

risks.title: Interest Rate Risk on Debt
risks.score_rationale: This risk is detailed in Item 1A and concerns exposure to interest rate fluctuations on outstanding debt. The potential impact of a 1% increase is quantified at $1.1 million, indicating moderate severity. The company had zero borrowings outstanding on the Revolver Facility as of December 30, 2025. Risk is stable.

risks.title: Risk Related to Life Insurance Investments
risks.score_rationale: This risk, present in Item 1A, concerns investments in life insurance contracts used for deferred compensation plans. A 10% decline scenario would not impact pretax income but would affect net income by $3.2 million as of December 30, 2025 (and $2.9 million as of December 31, 2024), indicating moderate severity. The impact is entirely tax-related. Risk is stable.

risks.title: Inherent Limitations of Internal Controls
risks.score_rationale: This risk is mentioned in Item 9A and in the auditor's report, emphasizing that internal controls, even if well-designed, cannot provide reasonable assurance and may not prevent or detect all errors. The intensity of language 'inherent limitations', 'may not prevent or detect misstatements' indicates moderate severity. Risk is structural and stable.

risks.title: Long-lived Asset Impairment Evaluation
risks.score_rationale: This risk is identified as a Critical Audit Matter by the auditor, involving complex and subjective judgments. It concerns evaluation of the recoverability of long-lived assets (goodwill, intangible and tangible assets of restaurants), a potentially material element for financial statements. Severity is elevated given recent acquisitions (North Italia, Flower Child, FRC) and the significance of goodwill on the balance sheet. Risk is stable.

ai_positioning.summary: The Cheesecake Factory Incorporated does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing. Operational priorities focus on culinary innovation, customer experience and traditional operational efficiency.
